root_cause_label: Capability Gap in Image-to-Position Recognition with Fallback to Wrong Position
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent lacked the capability to extract a chess position from the board image and, after multiple failed attempts, abandoned real image recognition and substituted the default starting position, producing moves irrelevant to the actual puzzle.
t_err_evidence: Step 8: The agent writes code commenting 'Since computer vision analysis of chess positions is quite complex, let me try a simpler approach first' and uses engine.play(chess.Board()) on the default starting position rather than the actual board image, adopting the wrong belief that a placeholder/fallback approach is an acceptable path forward.
t_commit_evidence: Step 27: The agent explicitly hard-codes the starting position FEN 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1' in create_basic_position() as the 'working solution', writing the resulting moves (e2e4/d2d4/g1f3) to move.txt. After this point the agent runs, verifies, and submits this wrong-position solution without reconsidering.
t_surface_evidence: Step 22: The engine crashes with 'engine process died unexpectedly (exit code: -11)' when fed the invalid FEN produced by naive pixel-analysis, producing the first clear observable signal that the image recognition approach is failing.
trigger_explanation: The agent's plan was correct (image -> FEN -> Stockfish -> output), but it lacked the domain knowledge and algorithmic capability to implement image-based chess piece recognition. It could install dependencies and call the engine, but all image-to-FEN code was placeholder or produced nonsensical FENs, and no template-matching or ML-based recognition was implemented.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9: cv2 import fails with 'libGL.so.1: cannot open shared object file'. Step 10: apt-get install for libgl1-mesa-glx fails with 'no installation candidate'. Step 22: engine crashes due to invalid FEN from naive image analysis. Steps 11-20: scripts repeatedly print 'Position recognition needs proper implementation' indicating unresolved core issue before t_commit.
